sampleArticles.title: Trump expands use of tariffs to reach national security goals
sampleArticles.description: The Trump administration is using trade negotiations to achieve national security goals, including containing China’s strategic influence, documents show.

sampleArticles.title: Walmart knew about explosion risk in water bottles for 7 years before recall
sampleArticles.description: The retailer knew since 2018 that the bottle lids could be “forcefully ejected.” But the path to a safety recall is surprisingly complicated.

sampleArticles.title: Trump replaces IRS Commissioner Billy Long after 2 months
sampleArticles.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will serve as acting head of the IRS, according to people familiar with the matter, and Billy Long will now serve as ambassador to Iceland.
